rows.Kwic: 不落言詮，不墮理路，不入思惟，不容擬議，千變萬化，八面受敵者，謂之活句
rows.sourceTitle: 雲門麥浪懷禪師宗門設難

Override.AttributionNote: Mailang Minghuai's Questions Set Up for the Chan House (雲門麥浪懷禪師宗門設難): in his Questions Set Up for the Chan House, Mailang Minghuai directly defines a living phrase through eight observable constraints.
